info.name: Lab Manager - Order Department Route
info.description: API for lab manager to reorder departments for the lab workflow. Updates departments.sort_order instead of creating a pivot table.

request.description: Set the ordered department workflow for the lab. The array index determines the new sort_order (0 = first). Departments must belong to the same lab, be operational (sort_order > 0), and not management. The response includes each department's time estimate and the total estimated time for the route.

response.name: Success (200)
Invalid Department (400)

request.description: List all departments for the lab manager's lab. Shows current sort_order.

response.name: Success (200)
